basic_info.description: This beautiful home has been cherished for many years, benefiting from both loving care and thoughtful, well-planned additions that blend seamlessly with the original structure. The main level offers the spacious kitchen, bathed in natural light. Adjacent to the kitchen is a dining room featuring elegant box beam ceilings, and a welcoming sunroom, complete with a built-in daybed, perfect for relaxing and taking in the picturesque views. This level also includes two generously sized bedrooms, a split bath, and a laundry area. Upstairs, the gracious top floor serves as a true retreat. The expansive living room is ideal for relaxing or entertaining, while the primary suite offers a peaceful haven with sweeping, panoramic views, a private deck, large closets, and en suite bath. Outside, the garden invites you to unwind around the fire pit, with plenty of space for play. A large basement provides ample storage or potential for further customization. The home is set on a quiet block of the Bayview. At the heart of the neighborhood, Third Street corridor is a bustling artery that serves as the main thoroughfare, boasting a community of beloved independent restaurants, shops, and services. The new Southeast Community Center is just five minutes away.
